[[File:Spot-Light_Sloth.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Spotlight sloth/Legends|Spotlight sloth]] with Lahdia plant]]

'''Lahdia plants''' were [[Plant/Legends|plants]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. The berries of this plant were surrounded by leaves, which could only be opened by the lights on the [[Spotlight sloth/Legends|Spotlight sloth's]] stomach.
